subject: Dictation that gets makolet and arnona right
preheader: A free on-device dictation app for English with Hebrew words in it.
paragraphs: I'm helping Daniel Rosehill share Hebrish, and your members came to mind.
It is free English dictation that writes words like makolet, arnona and teudat zehut in one consistent spelling. It runs on the phone or computer, so audio stays on the device.
It is a one-person, not-for-profit project. Apps for Android, Ubuntu and Windows are at [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
Would you be open to mentioning it to your members?
